$comment: Source of truth for icon metadata. SVG geometry lives in ./svg. Run `node scripts/icons/build-chatprd-icons.mjs` after editing.

icons.name: branch
icons.concept: Branch (a chat or a code branch)

spotTones.$comment: Tone variants of every spot. Source SVGs keep brand hexes; codegen maps each fill to a role (lead/second/accent tone or neutral) and re-renders it per tone. In non-brand tones the second family maps onto the tone's own family via secondTone (base → light) so the two planes stay distinct. Raw exports: color/<tone>/<name>.svg.

tint.$comment: Line icon geometry, lead-color stroke, closed shapes filled at 18% (the app DuotoneIcon treatment).

spotSmall.$comment: Simplified 24×24 drawings of every spot for 20–32px. Same lead family and role tokens as the full spot, at most two tones plus white. Source: color-small/<name>.svg; tone exports: color-small/<tone>/<name>.svg.

appPalette.$comment: ChatPRD app tones. Spots render with these CSS variables when tone is "app" or "app-<family>"; hexes are the fallbacks (light) and the dark-mode values for previews. Green and orange are reserved for states and aren't spot families.

gold.meaning: trust / protection (security shield); no app token yet, so the hex fallback applies

spotRules.$comment: Neutrals (white, paper, gray, charcoal, ink) are real materials; brand color (pink, coral, purple) marks the meaningful part. Green/amber/red/blue are small semantic accents only. Gold is the semantic trust color and leads the security shield only.
